meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Best Of Puppy Interviews, Tom Hiddleston & Chris Hemsworth Play With Puppies, Ryan Gosling & Ryan Reynolds Play With Puppies, Zac Efron & Jackie Chan Play With Puppies, Margot Robbie & Brie Larson Play With Puppies
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
